text:
Sami: heads-up — e2e perf gate just failed on main, p99 latency up ~7% vs baseline. CI is red for the perf-run job. anyone free to triage? :eyes:
CI-bot: perf-run (main) failed · job: e2e-perf-gate · build: https://ci.redwood.local/builds/8842 · artifacts: /artifacts/8842/perf/*
Jordan: grabbing logs now. which scenario regressed?
Sami: looks like `chat-heavy-16` and `streaming-gen` show the biggest delta. attaching quick paste of the diff from the dashboard:
```
scenario: chat-heavy-16
baseline p99: 120ms
current p99: 128ms
delta: +6.7% (+8ms)
```
Sami: note the run used model variant `redwood-l14-q4f16` on gpu pool `dedicated-a`
Nina: any recent infra or runtime changes landed to main in last 12h?
Jordan: there's a PR merged ~3 hours ago that tweaked kernel selection heuristics (PR #2145). might be related. cc @Alex who reviewed that.
Alex: I reviewed it but didn't expect a perf regression on short sequences. I'll bisect if you want me to. Can someone drop the exact failing build id?
Sami: build 8842 is the red one. re-run link is on the CI page. also here's the raw tail of the serving logs showing a spike when batching kicked in:
```
[2026-03-02T14:03:12Z] request_id=abcd1234 seq_len=64 batch_size=12 latency=45ms
[2026-03-02T14:03:12Z] request_id=abcd1235 seq_len=16 batch_size=16 latency=88ms
[2026-03-02T14:03:13Z] request_id=abcd1240 seq_len=8  batch_size=24 latency=120ms  <-- p99 cluster
```
Jordan: odd that batch_size is higher for small seqs there. maybe batching thresholds changed.
Nina: can we re-run the e2e perf job pinned to the previous commit to confirm regression range? I can queue that if someone gives the commit hash.
Sami: previous green was build 8830 -> commit `a1f2b3c`. current bad is on `d4e5f6g`.
Alex: I'll start a local bisect: run perf on `a1f2b3c..d4e5f6g` to find the offending commit. give me ~30–45m.
DeployBot: auto-alert: all canary rollouts paused for `redwood-l14-q4f16` until perf gate is cleared.
Jordan: pinged infra to double-check if any kernel blobs changed on `dedicated-a` earlier today.
Alex: quick note — PR #2145 toggled `batch_by_seq_len=true` by default and adjusted the batching window from 12ms -> 20ms. that could increase batch coalescing and hurt short-sequence p99. I'll test toggling that flag locally.
Sami: thanks. if it's that flag, we should consider reverting or gating it behind an experiment.
Alex: confirmed locally: with `batch_by_seq_len=false` p99 goes back inline with baseline. with it true + 20ms window we reproduce the +6–7% increase.
Nina: nice repro. so actionable options: 1) revert PR #2145, 2) reduce batching window, or 3) make the feature opt-in for low-latency routes.
Jordan: from an ops perspective we should revert in main to restore the gate and unblock rollouts, then iterate on a safer rollout. anyone object?
Sami: agree with revert to minimize customer impact. Alex — can you open the revert PR?
Alex: on it. filing revert PR now -> https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2261 (revert: PR #2145). CI will run; please watch e2e perf after merge.
CI-bot: PR #2261 opened by Alex. CI: queued.
Sami: once CI passes, can someone trigger a full e2e perf-run or just re-run the original job 8842? prefer a fresh run on latest main.
Nina: I'll trigger the job after the revert merges, and I'll leave a note to roll back the batching change behind a feature flag with a short canary window.
Jordan: thanks everyone. follow-up: Alex, paste the minimal test commands you used to repro so infra can add it to flakiness checks.
Alex: here you go:
```
# repro script
./scripts/run-e2e-perf --scenario chat-heavy-16 --model redwood-l14-q4f16 --commit d4e5f6g --reps 5
# toggle batching flag locally
export RW_BATCH_BY_SEQ_LEN=false
```
Sami: solid. will monitor the revert PR and the subsequent perf job. tagging @release-eng once we have green to resume canaries. :white_check_mark:
DeployBot: note: canaries will remain paused until manual resume after perf green.
Alex: revert PR merged (now at 1766001800). CI reported e2e perf job queued for a fresh run.
Nina: kicked off fresh perf-run against main (post-revert). job 8850. dashboard: https://perf.redwood.local/runs/8850
Jordan: early numbers look good — p99 back to baseline for the first few buckets.
Sami: fantastic work, team. we'll keep the batching change behind a flag and do a staged rollout. closing thread after we confirm final job 8850 is green. :v:
